title: Two people, one desk
body: Started in a co-working space in Indiranagar with a single retainer and a spreadsheet.

title: First measurement hire
body: Took on our first client past ₹10 Cr in annual media and learned that tracking is the whole job.

title: The studio opens
body: Brought creative in-house so media and creative stopped emailing each other and started sitting together.

title: Fourteen people, twenty-two accounts
body: Still no account managers, still no percentage-of-spend fees, still turning down more work than we take.
